target: new: tolerance of an environmental condition (resistant to PATO_0001178 towards cold)
reason: A disposition of the whole plant towards an environmental factor; PATO resistant to (PATO_0001178) is relational and needs the factor as its second term, which no current pattern supplies.
Meaning unclear for berries (early appearing? erumpent?); without the source context it is not a definable quality.
The earlier review maps arcuate to PATO:0000406 curved, so 'not arcuate' is its negation.
'Not spurred' means no spur. For the corolla, PO has corolla spur. For a leaf-blade base PO has no spur class, so those statements stay unannotated.

target: raphide idioblast (no PO class; would need a FLOPO anatomy class under idioblast PO_0000283) absent
reason: A real, taxonomically used absence statement. The absence of the broader idioblast PO_0000283 would claim too much, so it needs a narrower bearer class first.
Piliform = hair-like; the earlier review maps 'hair-like' to PATO:0104351 filiform.
A tuberized root, rhizome or stem base is thickened like a tuber: FLOPO:0991109 tuberous.

target: docs/odp/09-relation-to-another-part.md (fused with PATO_0000642 towards receptacle PO_0009064)
reason: Fusion with a named part of another kind is the relation pattern, like 'adnate to the petals'.

target: new: compound shape of two faces (hemispheroid PATO_0005000 and pyramidal PATO_0002336)
reason: A trilete spore with a hemispherical distal face and a pyramidal proximal face. Both values hold at once on different faces, so it is not a continuum between the two words.
Bracts or leaves that form an involucre are involucral bracts; the word names the part, not a quality.

target: docs/odp/10-ratio-to-another-part.md (count equal to that of another whorl)
reason: Isomerous = as many members as the other whorls (e.g. stamens as many as petals); this is an equality of counts with a second term.
A count of ovules ('few'), like 'few-flowered'; ovulate is already in flora_counted_parts.tsv.
French 'trinerves' = 3-nerved, a count of veins. 'À la base' means basal veins; when the laterals arise above the base it is FLOPO:0991202 triplinerved.

target: new: two values that both hold (curved PATO_0000406 and anastomosing FLOPO:0991128); on the leaf = brochidodromous PATO_0001970
reason: Secondary veins that both arch and join near the margin. Both qualities hold together, so the continuum reading of hyphenated words would be wrong.
A bracteole is a kind of bract, so outer sepals that look like bracteoles are bract-like.
Filaments or stipules joined up to the top are like parts fused along their whole length: connate. 'To the apex' is the extent, kept in the source words.
Without a joint where the part separates: the negation of FLOPO:0991154 jointed.

label: palustrine
definition: A positional quality inhering in a plant by virtue of its growing in marshes, swamps or other permanently waterlogged ground. NOTE: Probably outside PATO's scope (where an organism lives); sibling of FLOPO:0991112 aquatic, FLOPO:0991111 terrestrial and FLOPO:0991193 emergent.
reason: A habitat value of the same kind as aquatic and terrestrial already in FLOPO; marsh plants are not necessarily aquatic.
'2-3-fide', '2-fides' are counts of lobes; fid is already in flora_counted_parts.tsv. Bare '-fides' is a fragment that loses its number.

target: docs/odp/09-relation-to-another-part.md (fused with PATO_0000642 towards pedicel PO_0030112)
reason: Fusion with a named part of another kind is the relation pattern.
French 'replié' = folded back on itself (style, filaments in bud). 'Replié vers le centre' could also be FLOPO:0991145 inflexed.
'Sub-' + rosette = nearly in a rosette, the approximate-value pattern on FLOPO:0991005 rosulate. 'subroseltaires' is an OCR form.
'Appendage' is a generic part with no PO class; its absence has no bearer to point to (as the earlier review rejected generic parts).
Curvilinear basal veins are curved veins. 'Spines arranged in curvilinear patterns' is an arrangement and stays unannotated.
States that domatia are present; the FLOPO anatomy class exists.
French 'fauve' = tawny or fulvous, a dull yellowish brown, mostly of indumentum; PATO yellow brown is the nearest colour.

target: new: tolerance of an environmental condition (resistant to PATO_0001178 towards fire)
reason: As cold-resistant: a disposition with an environmental second term. 'Roots survive fire' is the same idea worded as a process.

target: continuum of a hyphenated compound (docs/flora-annotation-playbook.md, chain_from_phrase): linear PATO_0001199 - oblanceolate PATO_0002330
reason: The examples read 'linéaires-oblancéolées' (linear-oblanceolate), not obclavate. It is a compound of two shape values and is read as a continuum.
An inflorescence of many fascicles ('pauci- à multifasciculées') is a count of clusters. The part 'fascicle' would need adding to flora_counted_parts.tsv.
'Orné de 3 crêtes' only means 'bearing'; the content is the crests or appendages named after it. Like 'covered' in the earlier review, it is meaningless without that second term.
